label: 네이버 검색광고 Naver Search Ads
terms_note: '1. Sign up for NAVER SEARCH ADVERTISER's Center 2. Go to manage.searchad.naver.com 3. Go to Tools > API Manager 4. Create API license' — self-serve; HMAC-SHA256 signed requests (X-Signature). Rate limits: published in the API notice (not read). Free.

discovery.auth: hmac (API license + secret key from 광고시스템 도구 > API 관리자; X-Timestamp / X-API-KEY / X-Customer / X-Signature headers)
sdks: https://github.com/naver/searchad-apidoc (official samples: java-sample, php-sample, python-sample, csharp-sample)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Naver Search Ad API) Confidence: **high** — official GitHub repository read (Swagger UI itself is JS-only).
auth: 1. Sign up at searchad.naver.com; open manage.searchad.naver.com → Tools > API Manager → Create API license (API key + secret key); note the CUSTOMER_ID.
2. Sign every request: `X-Timestamp` (ms), `X-API-KEY`, `X-Customer`, `X-Signature` = base64(HMAC-SHA256(secret, `{timestamp}.{method}.{path}`)) — as in the official samples.
3. No OAuth; the license belongs to the advertiser (or agency with linked customers).

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: API license (access license) from NAVER Search Advertiser's Center > Tools > API Manager, sent as X-API-KEY.

fields.name: secret_key
fields.help: The license's secret key; signs every request: X-Signature = base64(HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<X-Timestamp ms>.<METHOD>.<path>")).

config_fields.name: customer_id
config_fields.help: Numeric advertiser customer id (shown in the Search Advertiser's Center), sent as X-Customer and as customerId in campaign updates.

me.note: GET /billing/bizmoney: the advertiser's bizmoney (prepaid balance) record for the X-Customer account; verifies the license, secret and customer id.

list_campaigns.note: GET /ncc/campaigns?recordSize=… (campaigns of the X-Customer account, a JSON array). `budget` is dailyBudget in KRW, applied only when useDailyBudget is true (in raw); userLock=true means paused. Paging is cursor-style (baseSearchId + selector), so only the first page is returned; `account_id` and `status` are not sent.

get_report.note: GET /stats?id=<campaign_id>&fields=["impCnt","clkCnt","salesAmt","ctr","cpc","ccnt"]&timeRange={"since","until"}&timeIncrement=1: daily stats of one campaign (KST days). campaign_id is REQUIRED (the endpoint reports one entity). `spend` is salesAmt, the cost in KRW including VAT. `account_id` is not sent (X-Customer selects the account).

update_budget.note: PUT /ncc/campaigns/{campaign_id}?fields=budget {nccCampaignId, customerId, useDailyBudget: true, dailyBudget} sets the campaign's daily budget in whole KRW (an integer; fractional values are refused) and switches the daily cap on. This spends money. `currency` is ignored (KRW).

pause_resume.note: PUT /ncc/campaigns/{campaign_id}?fields=userLock {nccCampaignId, customerId, userLock}: userLock=true pauses (the advertiser's ON/OFF switch), false resumes. Naver's sample client (Campaigns.update) sends the Campaign object with fields=userLock.

not_offered.list_accounts: Requests are made for one advertiser selected by X-Customer; linked client accounts (GET /customer-links?type=MYCLIENTS, used in Naver's sample code) are an agency feature whose response fields the reference does not document (https://naver.github.io/searchad-apidoc/).
